svg.text: Sky-Diode-Relay: 200 m – 20 km NLOS Troposcatter & Optical Relay
Ordered Build D: 2.4 GHz Troposcatter/Canopy-Bounce + VK7MO Keyed-FHSS Lock-In (23/23 Tests Passing)
Primary Trailcam Core (`pi-diode-trailcam`)
• Pico 2 Gatekeeper + QMC5883L + HLK-LD2450 Radar
• High-Side 12V Load Switch -> 5V 5A Buck Converter
• Raspberry Pi 5 + IMX708 NoIR + 940 nm Night IR
• Ed25519 Signed UDP (DD\x01 Meta + DD\x02 Chunks)
• Scenario A: Direct OS2 Fiber (30 m – 10 km, 0.35 dB/km)
• Scenario B1: 200 m Fiber -> Buried Woods Dead-Drop Vault
• Scenario B2: 1310 nm COTS Fiber Collimator (5 m – 100 m)
• Zero RF emissions at camera tree (`0.00 W RF`)
UDP-to-Sky Bridge (`DD\x01` + `DD\x02` -> `SKFG`)
1. Deduplicates 3x UDP carousel from sender_node.py
2. Bit-interleaved Extended Hamming(8,4) SECDED + Erasure FEC
3. Feeds Build D 2.4 GHz SDR or Build A/B/C Optical TX
4. Reassembles verified `.jpg` into `receiver_hub.py`
Ordered Build D: 200 m – 20 km NLOS Troposcatter
• TX: Pico 2 H + ADALM-PLUTO SDR + Skyworks SE2576L 1W PA
• RX: Mini-Circuits VBF-2435+ Filter + SKY65405 1.2dB NF LNA
• Antennas: 2x L-com HG2414P 14 dBi Outdoor Flat Panels
• Enclosures & Power: 2x Hammond 1590Z120 IP66 + 2x LS50-5 5V
• Physics: ITU-R P.617 Troposcatter + Rain/Snow Hydrometeor
Scatter (`+14 dB` to `+62 dB` SNR across all Finnish seasons)
6-Layer Electronic Anti-Jamming Stack
1. Keyed-FHSS Hopping Across 2370–2500 MHz (`2380/2488/2459 MHz`)
(2 of 3 passes sit in out-of-ISM guard bands outside Wi-Fi jammers)
2. Barrage-Jammer Pass Rejection + Inverse-Noise-Variance Combining
3. Pulsed/Chirp Burst Blanker + 2D Costas Lock-In (`+55.8 dB` gain)
Optical Modes Also Supported in Code (`23/23` Tests):
• Build A: 1550 nm DFB FSO | Build B: 265 nm UV-C NLOS
• Build C: 20 km Hybrid Optical + VK7MO Lock-In
